title: Oluwagbemiga Ajimokunola Olofin-Adimula
content:
Oba Oluwagbemiga Ajimokunola Olofin-Adimula (born Oluwagbemiga Ojo on October 2, 1972) is a Nigerian lawyer and traditional ruler. Since 2021, he has served as the Iralepo of Isinkan, a traditional state in Akure South Local Government Area of Ondo State, Nigeria.
His position as a monarch has been challenged by a neighboring ruler, the Deji of Akure Oba Aladetoyinbo Ogunlade Aladelusi. The case he instituted is currently in the Nigerian courts.
